subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should OpenClaw expose append as optional `append?: boolean` on the existing `write` tool, or require a different user/model-facing append API before this data-loss fix lands?
rationale: The implementation is technically plausible and default-preserving, but it expands the model-facing tool contract and backend operation contract, which is a maintainer product/API choice rather than an automation repair decision.

options.title: Accept append flag after final checks
options.body: Approve `append?: boolean` on `write` as the smallest default-preserving fix, then land one append candidate after exact-head CI and owner review are clean.

options.title: Request a different append API
options.body: Ask contributors to reshape the implementation around a string `mode` or dedicated append tool if maintainers want stronger semantic separation from overwrite.

options.title: Pick a single landing branch
options.body: Select either this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102243 as the landing vehicle and close or pause the other to avoid parallel drift.

recommendation.title: Accept append flag after final checks
recommendation.body: Approve `append?: boolean` on `write` as the smallest default-preserving fix, then land one append candidate after exact-head CI and owner review are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining blocker is the model-facing agent tool API shape, and steipete has the strongest adjacent agent runtime/product-boundary history in the inspected source.
